title: VE2CUY Invaders
description: A Space Invaders-inspired game written in Z80 assembly for this project. English or French, chosen on the title screen.
controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to fire, Break (Esc) quits.
license: Written by VE2CUY for this project (source code: asm/invaders.asm)

title: VE2CUY Invaders (cassette)
description: The same game, loaded from a 500-baud cassette image (.CAS) like a SYSTEM tape.
controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to fire, Break (Esc) quits.
license: Written by VE2CUY for this project (source code: asm/invaders.asm)

title: Sea Dragon
description: Steer a submarine through an undersea cavern, dodging mines and depth charges.
controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to fire. Shift+Break (Shift+Esc) quits.

title: Armored Patrol
description: First-person tank battle in a 3-D landscape.
controls: Instructions are shown in the game. Shift+Break (Shift+Esc) quits.
